stories.title: Bohm homer saves Phillies' season after Harper fielding gaffe, tying HR
stories.summary: Alec Bohm put Philadelphia ahead with a two-out home run in the 10th inning, and the Phillies beat the Braves to force a decisive Game 3 in their National League Wild Card Series.

stories.title: Red Sox's Anthony out of ALWC with hand, wrist injuries; Mead in
stories.summary: Red Sox outfielder Roman Anthony has been ruled out of the AL Wild Card Series and the foreseeable future after damaging muscles in his wrist during Game 1, Red Sox manager Chad Tracy said Wednesday.

stories.title: Titans QB Ward on fans' threats to his family: 'People are weird'
stories.summary: Titans quarterback Cam Ward on Wednesday addressed fans' threats to his family on social media.

stories.title: McVay: NFL told Rams DPI was wrong call on pivotal play vs. Broncos
stories.summary: Rams head coach Sean McVay says the NFL told the team that defensive pass interference should not have been called against cornerback Josh Wallace in Sunday night's loss to the Broncos.

stories.title: Maye again says shoulder not to blame for sputtering Patriots offense
stories.summary: Drake Maye said Wednesday the physical condition of his right shoulder hasn't affected his throwing ability, instead highlighting the need to make better decisions to reverse his early-season struggles in the Patriots' 1-2 start.
